ILLUSTRATIVE UI COMPONENTS · NO LIVE CATALOGUE
THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
ComponentRequired statesDesign behavior
Navigation & searchDefault, focus, results, loading, emptyClear labels, visible focus and a predictable content grid.
Buttons & linksDefault, hover, focus, disabled, loadingOne clear primary action. Explain a disabled action when needed.
Form fieldsLabel, help, focus, error, successPersistent labels and specific, recoverable errors.
Content cardsDefault, loading, unavailableAccurate copy and image dimensions reserved to avoid layout shift.
Status messagesInformative, success, errorUse words or icons alongside color; announce updates accessibly.
01

Responsive foundation

Keep body text at 16 px, use flexible columns and test reflow at narrow widths and enlarged text.

02

Crawlable pages

Render meaningful content in the initial HTML, use real anchor links and give every useful page its own descriptive URL and metadata.

03

Honest UX copy

Describe the current state and the next step. Avoid fabricated dates, hidden conditions or misleading button labels.
